name: Skull Crusher
description: The skull crusher is a lying triceps extension exercise performed on a bench with an EZ-curl bar or dumbbells. By lowering the bar toward the forehead or skull from a fully extended arm position, the triceps are trained through a full range of elbow flexion and extension with particular emphasis on the long head.

execution.starting_position: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-curl bar with a narrow pronated grip. Press the bar to full extension above the chest with upper arms vertical.
execution.setup_instructions: Keep the upper arms perpendicular to the floor throughout. The bar moves in an arc from above the chest toward the forehead.
steps: With upper arms stationary and vertical, lower the bar by bending the elbows.
Lower toward the forehead or slightly behind the head to maximize long-head stretch.
Extend the elbows to press the bar back to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale on the descent toward the forehead. Exhale on extension.
common_mistakes: Allowing the elbows to flare outward widely
Moving the upper arms — the elbows should hinge, not the shoulder
safety_considerations: Use a spotter for heavy sets — the bar is directly above the face
Do not bounce or lose control at the bottom
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Lower until the bar almost touches the forehead or slightly behind it. Full extension at the top.
coaching_cues: Keep your elbows pointing straight at the ceiling throughout
The bar moves like a hinge — upper arms do not move
